Odisha Police faces significant personnel shortage, says DGP

The Director General of Police (DGP) of Odisha has stated that the state's police force is experiencing a substantial shortage of personnel. Approximately 33,000 posts are currently vacant within the Odisha Police department. This situation highlights a critical challenge in maintaining adequate law enforcement capacity in the state.
